summary.text:
Global equity markets rallied as volatility retreated, with the VIX dropping 11.16% to 23.81. Wall Street advanced, led by the Nasdaq surging 2.61% and the S&P 500 rising 1.6%. Asian stocks gained sharply, paced by a 3.73% rise in the Shanghai Composite. European equities also climbed, despite S&P cutting France’s credit outlook to negative.

The dollar index rose 0.33% to 104.014, while the euro slipped to 1.0939 and the yen weakened to 159.515. Gold surged 3.93% to 3674.6001. In contrast, oil weakened significantly, with Brent down 4.77% to 90.1 and WTI falling 1.03% to 82.82. Bitcoin declined 1.0% to 59889.6289.

Investors are watching central bank rhetoric after ECB officials signaled further interest rate hikes to combat inflation. Markets will also monitor legal tensions following OpenAI countersuing Apple for trade secret theft, alongside geopolitical developments surrounding Taipei's election.
